question: A, B and C can complete a task in 2, 8 and 8 days, respectively. Working together, how long (in days) will they take to complete three times that amount of work?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

A = 1/2, B = 1/8, C = 1/8

Total efficiency = 1/2 + 1/8 + 1/8 = 3/4

Time for 1 work = 4/3 days

For 3 works ⇒ 3 × (4/3) = 4

**∴ Answer = 4 days**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

A completes work in 2 days, B in 8 days, C in 8 days

**Formula used:**

Efficiency = Total Work ÷ Time

Total Work = 8 units

**Calculation:**

⇒ Combined efficiency = 4 + 1 + 1 = 6 units/day

⇒ Time for 1 work = 8 ÷ 6 = 4/3 days

⇒ Time for 3 works = 3 × (4/3)

⇒ = 4 days

**∴ The correct answer is 4 days.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Efficiency Addition

When people work together, their efficiencies are added.

LCM Method

Taking LCM helps avoid fractions.

Multiple Work Concept

Time for n works = n × time for one work.
